test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The current population of a village is 1000 and its population is increasing at the rate of 10% every year. What will be the population of the village after three years?
solution:
Given:

Population (P) = 1000

Percentage (R) = 10%

Time (T) = 3 years 

Formula used:

Total population = P( 1 + R/100)T 

Calculations:

According to question,

1000 × (1 + 10/100)3 

= 1000 × (11/10)3 

= 1000 × (1331/1000)

= 1331

∴ 1331 is the population after 3 years .
